# Environment

```{r}
# Packages
packages <- c("tidyverse", "scales", "ggtext", "ggalluvial")

# Load packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))

# Print environment
set.seed(45)
Sys.info()
sessionInfo()

# Themes
source("./lib/consistent_themes.R")
source("./lib/processed_data_functions.R")

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, scipen = 999)

probe_set_levels <- c("Set 1", "Set 2 (wo6K)")
probe_set_colors <- c(
  "Set 1" = "#1B9E77",
  "Set 2 (wo6K)" = "#7570B3"
)

coverage_status_levels <- c(
  "Fully covered",
  "Partially covered",
  "Not covered"
)

coverage_status_colors <- c(
  "Fully covered" = "#1B9E77",
  "Partially covered" = "#E6AB02",
  "Not covered" = "#D95F02"
)
```

# Load data

```{r data}
set_1_data <- readRDS(
  "./data/probe_mapping/curated/probe_mapping_data.RDS"
)
set_2_data <- readRDS(
  paste0(
    "./data/probe_mapping/deprecated/",
    "reference_probe_coverage_data_wo6K.RDS"
  )
)

validate_processed_data(set_1_data)
validate_processed_data(set_2_data)

gene_keys <- c("gene_index", "seqid", "start", "end")

set_1_genes <- set_1_data$gene_coverage %>%
  select(
    all_of(gene_keys),
    gene_id,
    locus_tag,
    gene_symbol,
    set_1_covered_bp = covered_bp,
    set_1_coverage_percent = coverage_percent,
    set_1_coverage_status = coverage_status
  )

set_2_genes <- set_2_data$gene_coverage %>%
  select(
    all_of(gene_keys),
    set_2_covered_bp = covered_bp,
    set_2_coverage_percent = coverage_percent,
    set_2_coverage_status = coverage_status
  )

gene_comparison <- set_1_genes %>%
  inner_join(set_2_genes, by = gene_keys) %>%
  mutate(
    set_1_coverage_status = factor(
      set_1_coverage_status,
      levels = coverage_status_levels
    ),
    set_2_coverage_status = factor(
      set_2_coverage_status,
      levels = coverage_status_levels
    ),
    coverage_change = set_1_coverage_percent - set_2_coverage_percent,
    coverage_changed = abs(coverage_change) > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
    status_changed = set_1_coverage_status != set_2_coverage_status
  )

if (
  nrow(gene_comparison) != nrow(set_1_genes) ||
    nrow(gene_comparison) != nrow(set_2_genes) ||
    anyDuplicated(gene_comparison[gene_keys]) > 0
) {
  stop("The two probe sets did not match one-to-one across reference genes")
}
```

# Gene coverage flags

```{r coverage-flags}
status_counts <- bind_rows(
  gene_comparison %>%
    transmute(
      probe_set = "Set 1",
      coverage_status = set_1_coverage_status
    ),
  gene_comparison %>%
    transmute(
      probe_set = "Set 2 (wo6K)",
      coverage_status = set_2_coverage_status
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    probe_set = factor(probe_set, levels = probe_set_levels),
    coverage_status = factor(
      coverage_status,
      levels = coverage_status_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  count(probe_set, coverage_status, .drop = FALSE)

same_status_summary <- gene_comparison %>%
  filter(set_1_coverage_status == set_2_coverage_status) %>%
  count(`Coverage status in both sets` = set_1_coverage_status, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    `Coverage status in both sets`,
    `Genes with the same status` = n,
    `Percent of all genes` = 100 * n / nrow(gene_comparison)
  )

status_transition_summary <- with(
  gene_comparison,
  table(
    `Rows: Set 2 (wo6K)` = set_2_coverage_status,
    `Columns: Set 1` = set_1_coverage_status
  )
)

same_status_summary

addmargins(status_transition_summary)

p_status_counts <- ggplot(
  status_counts,
  aes(coverage_status, n, fill = probe_set)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.66,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = comma(n)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = probe_set_colors,
    breaks = probe_set_levels,
    name = "Probe set"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Level of probe coverage",
    y = "Genes"
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_status_counts
```

# Gene coverage flag transitions

```{r coverage-flag-transitions}
status_transitions <- gene_comparison %>%
  count(
    set_1_coverage_status,
    set_2_coverage_status,
    name = "genes",
    .drop = FALSE
  ) %>%
  group_by(set_1_coverage_status) %>%
  mutate(
    display_weight = genes / sum(genes),
    count_weight = if_else(
      display_weight > 0,
      genes / display_weight,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_status_transitions <- ggplot(
  status_transitions,
  aes(
    axis1 = set_1_coverage_status,
    axis2 = set_2_coverage_status,
    y = display_weight,
    weight = count_weight
  )
) +
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = set_1_coverage_status),
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.75,
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    discern = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.18,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    discern = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    discern = TRUE,
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", after_stat(stratum)),
        "\n(n = ",
        comma(after_stat(count)),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Set 1 (current)", "Set 2 (wo6K)"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.18, 0.18))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = coverage_status_colors,
    breaks = coverage_status_levels,
    name = "Set 1 coverage status"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_status_transitions
```

# Partial gene coverage distributions

```{r partial-coverage-distributions}
partial_coverage_distribution <- bind_rows(
  gene_comparison %>%
    filter(set_1_coverage_status == "Partially covered") %>%
    transmute(
      probe_set = "Set 1",
      coverage_percent = set_1_coverage_percent
    ),
  gene_comparison %>%
    filter(set_2_coverage_status == "Partially covered") %>%
    transmute(
      probe_set = "Set 2 (wo6K)",
      coverage_percent = set_2_coverage_percent
    )
) %>%
  mutate(probe_set = factor(probe_set, levels = probe_set_levels))

p_partial_distributions <- ggplot(
  partial_coverage_distribution,
  aes(coverage_percent, fill = probe_set)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 2.5,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.55,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = probe_set_colors,
    breaks = probe_set_levels,
    name = "Probe set"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent covered by probes",
    y = "Partially covered genes"
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_partial_distributions
```

# Change in gene coverage (set 1 (new) - set 2 (old))

```{r coverage-change}
coverage_change_summary <- gene_comparison %>%
  summarise(
    genes = n(),
    increased = sum(coverage_change > sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)),
    unchanged = sum(!coverage_changed),
    decreased = sum(coverage_change < -sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)),
    status_changed = sum(status_changed),
    median_change = median(coverage_change),
    mean_change = mean(coverage_change)
  )

coverage_change_summary %>%
  favorite_kable()

p_coverage_change_all <- ggplot(
  gene_comparison,
  aes(coverage_change)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 2.5,
    center = 0,
    color = "white",
    fill = probe_set_colors[["Set 1"]]
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pretty_breaks(10),
    labels = label_number(suffix = " pp")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x = "Coverage change (Set 1 - Set 2)",
    y = "Genes",
    title = "All genes"
  ) +
  theme_figure

p_coverage_change_all

p_coverage_change_changed <- gene_comparison %>%
  filter(coverage_changed) %>%
  ggplot(aes(coverage_change)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 2.5,
    center = 0,
    color = "white",
    fill = probe_set_colors[["Set 1"]]
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pretty_breaks(10),
    labels = label_number(suffix = " pp")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x = "Coverage change (Set 1 - Set 2)",
    y = "Genes",
    title = "Genes with unchanged coverage removed"
  ) +
  theme_figure

p_coverage_change_changed
```

# Genes not covered by either probe set

```{r not-covered-genes}
not_covered_gene_changes <- gene_comparison %>%
  filter(
    set_1_coverage_status == "Not covered" |
      set_2_coverage_status == "Not covered"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    set_2_coverage_status,
    set_1_coverage_status,
    gene_index
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Gene = coalesce(gene_symbol, locus_tag, gene_id),
    `Locus tag` = locus_tag,
    `Set 1 status` = as.character(set_1_coverage_status),
    `Set 1 coverage (%)` = round(set_1_coverage_percent, 2),
    `Set 2 (wo6K) status` = as.character(set_2_coverage_status),
    `Set 2 (wo6K) coverage (%)` = round(set_2_coverage_percent, 2),
    `Change (Set 1 - Set 2, pp)` = round(coverage_change, 2)
  )

not_covered_gene_changes %>%
  favorite_kable()
```
